tools.name: describe_capabilities
tools.description: Describe supported engineering domains, limits and data version.

tools.name: search_materials
tools.description: Search curated Taminyaran local materials. Matches are candidates, not engineering approvals.

tools.name: get_material
tools.description: Get one curated material by asset_id.

tools.name: design_project
tools.description: Versioned preliminary engineering design. Executable guarded modules include CAL-011 pond, CAL-043 agricultural subsurface drain spacing, CAL-060/061 foundation, CAL-063/064 tunnel, and CAL-065/066/067 excavation groundwater screens. High-risk engineering remains human-review.

tools.name: project_intake
tools.description: Normalize a project brief into a stateless machine-readable engineering intake. Agricultural drainage routes to CAL-043 guardrails; excavation/foundation groundwater projects run CAL-065 network/perimeter, CAL-066 gravity HGL and CAL-067 pump TDH/wet-well screens. Missing values remain null and retu

tools.name: explain_design
tools.description: Explain a design_project payload supplied by the client. Stateless.

tools.name: prepare_quote_request
tools.description: Prepare a Taminyaran RFQ preview from an engineering design/BOQ. This tool NEVER submits. Show the returned summary to the user and obtain explicit confirmation before calling submit_quote_request.

tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.description: Submit a previously prepared RFQ to Taminyaran through the existing official quote form. CALL ONLY after the user explicitly confirms the exact prepare_quote_request summary. No arbitrary recipient is allowed. Do not retry automatically if submission status is unknown.

tools.name: case_create
tools.description: Create exactly one canonical Taminyaran Customer Hub case after the user explicitly requests it. This is a public-intake write: confirm_create must be true, phone/display_name/title are required, and idempotency_key prevents duplicate Case creation. The owner may resolve an existing Customer by norm

tools.name: conversation_whoami
tools.description: Resolve the represented-human/business context for an existing Taminyaran AI Web Chat thread capability. Read-only but capability-scoped. Put thread_token only in the MCP POST body; never place it in a URL, log, prompt transcript, or unrelated third-party system.

tools.name: project_design_status
tools.description: Read the current canonical Customer Hub project/design/quote status represented by an existing Taminyaran AI Web Chat thread capability. Revalidates thread status, expiry and business-context mapping on every call. Read-only and POST-body-only.

tools.name: conversation_read
tools.description: Read a bounded page of the canonical Taminyaran case conversation represented by an existing AI Web Chat thread capability. Returns public-safe message/attachment references, text, author role, channel and timestamps. Does not mark customer messages as read and performs no write. thread_token is POS

tools.name: conversation_attachment_resolve
tools.description: Resolve one public-safe attachment reference within the represented Taminyaran thread/case scope. Metadata is returned by default. Set include_content=true to retrieve supported content up to 2 MiB through an internal one-shot, subject-bound delivery; the response may contain base64 bytes but never

tools.name: conversation_send
tools.description: Request one exact represented-human message, optionally with one image attachment. Text-only behavior remains approval-gated as before. For an attachment, first call with attachment descriptor {name,content_type,size_bytes,sha256} and NO bytes; the exact human approves that descriptor/hash in Custom

tools.name: conversation_confirm_attested
tools.description: Approve or reject one pending TEXT-ONLY conversation_send after the external AI has explicitly asked its own user inside that AI chat. This is lower-assurance agent-attested user confirmation, not authenticated Customer Hub approval. Forbidden for attachments and higher-risk effects.

tools.name: solution_list
tools.description: List canonical Taminyaran Solutions and owner/calculator/MCP/Bridge/Dashboard contracts. Read-only.

tools.name: solution_resolve
tools.description: Resolve one canonical Taminyaran Solution by solution_id or exact public URL. Read-only.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: List all 34 live canonical calculators from Taminyaran Calculation Center. Planned Master Map items are not falsely presented as executable.

tools.name: get_calculator_spec
tools.description: Get the live field contract, source and risk class for one Taminyaran site calculator.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Run one of the 34 canonical calculators. Returns the engine result plus a versioned ty.artifact/1 envelope containing ty.design.core/1 and SHA-256 provenance.

tools.name: abiyar_describe
tools.description: Describe live Abyar production architecture, stages, sources and MCP guardrails.

tools.name: abiyar_get_taxonomy
tools.description: Read live Abyar crop taxonomy from Matrix. Optional query filters records.

tools.name: abiyar_get_crop
tools.description: Read one live Abyar crop/cultivar profile from Matrix and DB.

tools.name: abiyar_location_profile
tools.description: Get Abyar modeled location/climate-zone profile for supplied coordinates. Stateless and not persisted by MCP.

tools.name: abiyar_water_need
tools.description: Run Abyar 12-month irrigation water-need logic. Missing inputs are returned instead of guessed.

tools.name: abiyar_network_screen
tools.description: Abyar preliminary irrigation network capacity screen.

tools.name: abiyar_pond_design
tools.description: Run live Abyar rectangular pond geometry calculation.

tools.name: abiyar_context
tools.description: Build stateless Abyar context from crop and/or location and return next relevant calculations.

tools.name: abiyar_search_evidence
tools.description: Search active Abyar evidence by subject and/or agronomic domain. Returns source-linked evidence rows without generating new claims.

tools.name: abiyar_get_sources
tools.description: List authoritative Abyar research/data sources, optionally filtered by country or institution type.

tools.name: abiyar_get_varieties
tools.description: List canonical active cultivars/varieties for a crop from the D1-backed Abyar research layer.

tools.name: abiyar_get_rootstocks
tools.description: List canonical rootstocks for a crop with evidence, open conflicts, coverage and rootstock-context policy.

tools.name: abiyar_location_fingerprint
tools.description: Build/read the rounded environmental fingerprint used by Abyar variety-fit policy from location plus optional soil/water context.

tools.name: abiyar_variety_fit
tools.description: Run the canonical Abyar variety-fit policy for a crop and environmental fingerprint; optional cultivar/rootstock narrows context. MCP preserves upstream score and decision.

tools.name: abiyar_chill_profile
tools.description: Read the canonical multi-model chill profile (Chill Hours, Utah Units, Dynamic Chill Portions) by fingerprint or coordinates. Full seasonal detail is optional.

tools.name: abiyar_soil_assess
tools.description: Run Abyar conservative soil/lab/water screening. It computes safe derived indicators but withholds fertilizer dose without calibrated local evidence.

tools.name: abiyar_get_knowledge_cards
tools.description: Read reviewed farmer/engineer knowledge cards for a crop with evidence/source references and cautions.

tools.name: abiyar_get_provenance
tools.description: Trace provenance edges for a specific Abyar evidence ID.

tools.name: abiyar_calendar_feed
tools.description: Return location-aware Abyar crop calendar and weather alerts from the live calendar service. Forecast values are time-sensitive.

tools.name: abiyar_assess_suitability
tools.description: Orchestrate Abyar environmental fingerprint + canonical variety-fit + reviewed cards + optional cultivar evidence and conservative soil assessment. It does not invent a new composite score.

tools.name: workspace_describe
tools.description: Describe the separate Taminyaran Project Workspace state plane and bridge safety contract. Read-only; MCP itself remains stateless.

tools.name: workspace_create_project
tools.description: Create a persistent PII-free Project Workspace and return project_id + one-time project_key. Use only after the user explicitly asks to persist project state. Never put project_key in a URL.

tools.name: workspace_get_project
tools.description: Read persistent PII-free project state using explicit project_id + project_key capability handle.

tools.name: workspace_update_intake
tools.description: Replace the canonical PII-free project intake in Project Workspace. This increments intake_version; require explicit confirmation.

tools.name: workspace_run_intake
tools.description: Call canonical MCP project_intake for the stored intake and persist the returned run/version in Project Workspace. Requires confirmation because it stores a new run.

tools.name: workspace_add_evidence
tools.description: Append a PII-free evidence reference/status/hash/metadata record to Project Workspace. File bytes are not stored. Human verification is separate.

tools.name: workspace_review_readiness
tools.description: Read design-review blockers, evidence gates, red flags and commissioning readiness. Completeness never equals human engineering approval.

tools.name: workspace_get_handoff
tools.description: Read the structured project handoff: latest stored intake run, evidence matrix, decisions already made by private reviewer, decision-memo seed and commissioning checklist.

tools.name: workspace_rotate_key
tools.description: Rotate the Project Workspace capability key. Destructive to the old key; require explicit confirmation. The new key is shown once and is never stored by MCP.

tools.name: workspace_prepare_quote_handoff
tools.description: Prepare a PII-free quotation handoff from the current Project Workspace state. Read-only: creates no link and submits nothing. Returns a deterministic confirmation_code and preserves engineering HOLD/RED FLAG context.

tools.name: workspace_create_quote_handoff
tools.description: After explicit user confirmation of workspace_prepare_quote_handoff, create a temporary PII-free /q/ short link that opens the existing official Taminyaran quotation form. The user enters contact details in the form. This creates NO RFQ/inbox record by itself.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_quote_request" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Prepare a Taminyaran RFQ preview from an engineering design/BOQ. This tool NEVER submits. Show the returned summary to the user and obtain explicit confirmation…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "case_create" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: conversation_whoami, project_design_status, conversation_read, conversation_attachment_resolve, solution_resolve, workspace_review_readiness · Private data: case_create, abiyar_get_taxonomy, abiyar_get_crop, workspace_add_evidence, workspace_get_handoff, workspace_create_quote_handoff · Public sink: submit_quote_request, case_create, conversation_whoami, project_design_status, conversation_read, conversation_attachment_resolve, conversation_send · Destructive: project_intake, run_calculator, abiyar_water_need, abiyar_pond_design, abiyar_variety_fit, abiyar_soil_assess, workspace_run_intake, workspace_get_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: conversation_whoami, project_design_status, conversation_read, conversation_attachment_resolve, solution_resolve, workspace_review_readiness · Private data: case_create, abiyar_get_taxonomy, abiyar_get_crop, workspace_add_evidence, workspace_get_handoff, workspace_create_quote_handoff · Public sink: submit_quote_request, case_create, conversation_whoami, project_design_status, conversation_read, conversation_attachment_resolve, conversation_send · Destructive: project_intake, run_calculator, abiyar_water_need, abiyar_pond_design, abiyar_variety_fit, abiyar_soil_assess, workspace_run_intake, workspace_get_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
